name: Privatus Analytics
description: See how many real people visit your site, without cookies or a cookie pop-up. Paste your site ID and the plugin adds the Privatus Analytics script to every page.

features.0: No cookies and no IP addresses kept. Bots are filtered out.
features.1: Pick extra tracking: time on page, outside links and downloads, page speed, click maps and short surveys.
features.2: Your own visits are not counted while you are logged in.
features.3: Free plan with 10,000 events a month on up to 3 sites, no card needed.
